schema_note: Each profile contains only Config-compatible hardware and Source fields. This companion maps fields into full Config.sources paths and lists Config.assumptions.

hardware.name.description: Announced Atlas 960E UnifiedBus/NPO 4096-NPU shared-address scale-up architecture approximated as a 1024-NPU logical nonblocking fabric; physical switch graph and bisection are not published.

hardware.npus_per_host.description: Prior 8-card host grouping, not verified 960E/A7 chassis.

hardware.su_size.description: Announced Atlas 960E UnifiedBus/NPO 4096-NPU shared-address scale-up architecture approximated as a 1024-NPU logical nonblocking fabric; physical switch graph and bisection are not published.

hardware.topology.description: Announced Atlas 960E UnifiedBus/NPO 4096-NPU shared-address scale-up architecture approximated as a 1024-NPU logical nonblocking fabric; physical switch graph and bisection are not published.

hardware.npu.hbm_bytes.description: Manufacturer HUAWEI CONNECT 2026 roadmap slide, visually verified; future specification, not an achieved benchmark. Dense/sparse qualification is not stated.

hardware.npu.hbm_Bps.description: Manufacturer HUAWEI CONNECT 2026 roadmap slide, visually verified; future specification, not an achieved benchmark. Dense/sparse qualification is not stated.

hardware.npu.flops.fp8.description: Manufacturer HUAWEI CONNECT 2026 roadmap slide, visually verified; future specification, not an achieved benchmark. Dense/sparse qualification is not stated.

hardware.npu.flops.fp16.description: Uncalibrated value preserved exactly from prior Ascend 950DT experiment for comparability; not an announced 960/970 specification.

hardware.npu.flops.bf16.description: Uncalibrated value preserved exactly from prior Ascend 950DT experiment for comparability; not an announced 960/970 specification.

hardware.npu.flops.fp32.description: Uncalibrated value preserved exactly from prior Ascend 950DT experiment for comparability; not an announced 960/970 specification.

hardware.npu.workspace_bytes.description: Uncalibrated value preserved exactly from prior Ascend 950DT experiment for comparability; not an announced 960/970 specification.

hardware.cpu.*.description: Uncalibrated value preserved exactly from prior Ascend 950DT experiment for comparability; not an announced 960/970 specification.

hardware.host_link.*.description: Uncalibrated value preserved exactly from prior Ascend 950DT experiment for comparability; not an announced 960/970 specification.

hardware.scale_out.*.description: Unused in main all-SU profiles; repository legacy 400Gb/s/host fields retained solely to satisfy profile defaults. Not asserted as A6/A7 scale-out specification.

hardware.scale_up.bandwidth_Bps.description: Published chip total divided by two because direction is unspecified; applies to logical per-card edge and injection capacity.

hardware.scale_up.injection_Bps.description: Same one-way nominal budget as scale_up.bandwidth_Bps; endpoint injection contention constrains logical paths.

hardware.scale_up.latency_s.description: 2us published all-domain D2D RTT divided by two to approximate 1us end-to-end one-way logical path.

hardware.scale_up.efficiency.description: Uncalibrated value preserved exactly from prior Ascend 950DT experiment for comparability; not an announced 960/970 specification.

hardware.remote.enabled.description: No external-memory offload requested in the repeated workload; keep disabled.

hardware.ssd.enabled.description: No SSD offload requested in the repeated workload; keep disabled.

assumptions: Total 1024 NPUs is the user comparison constraint. 8 NPUs/host and contiguous 64-NPU rack groups are retained experimental grouping assumptions, not verified Atlas 960E or A7 physical BOM.

Main 960DT and 970 profiles set su_size=1024: all NPU-to-NPU traffic inside the selected 1024-card slice is scale-up. Zero scale-out payload does not mean zero cross-rack communication. Under uniform 16-rack placement, MoE traffic can still cross rack groups with approximately 15/16 probability.

topology=full_mesh represents direct logical end-to-end reachability through an ideal nonblocking switching fabric, not a claim of one physical hop or 1024-card all-to-all cables. No switch bisection, port allocation or oversubscription is invented.

Published chip interconnect bandwidth is 2.2 TB/s for 960 and 4.4 TB/s for 970. Direction is not stated. Simulation uses one-way nominal/injection values of 1.1 and 2.2 TB/s by halving the published totals, with inherited network efficiency 0.8.
Published 2us is an all-domain D2D RTT. Simulation uses 1us one-way latency for each logical path, an explicit conversion assumption; software collective cost is separate.
NPU efficiency 0.5 and all link efficiencies are uncalibrated prior assumptions. No measured 960/970 collective kernel or FP8 execution efficiency is implied.

FP16 and BF16 0.5 PFLOPS/card and FP32 50 TFLOPS/card remain prior baseline placeholders because verified 960/970 figures were not found. These are not extrapolated generation claims. FP32 may affect the KDA recurrent kernels even in a nominal FP8 inference workload.
CPU DRAM/capacity/IOPS, H2D and unused scale-out fields retain baseline placeholders. Remote memory and SSD remain disabled; no KV offload or OceanStor M900 is modeled.
Runtime reserve 8 GB/card and workspace 256 MB/card remain prior assumptions. All quantities use decimal SI bytes and bytes/s.
Selected 960DT continues the prior 950DT homogeneous hardware comparison. 960PR is not mixed into prefill; its different HBM subsystem requires a separate PD-disaggregation experiment.
The 2026 Ascend 970 roadmap photo specifies 3.6 PFLOPS FP8, 288 GB HBM, 14.4 TB/s and 4.4 TB/s interconnect; earlier 2025 4 PFLOPS/4 TB/s chip roadmap is historical.
2025 Atlas 960 15488-card/220-cabinet roadmap is not combined with the 2026 Atlas 960E 4096-card NPO system.
Switch 176 ports x 1.6 Tb/s and 280 Tb/s aggregate are link-device figures; Hi-ONE 7.2 Tb/s is per optical engine. None is directly assigned as per-NPU injection bandwidth.
Dense versus sparse qualification of peak FP8 FLOPS is unknown from inspected official material; the simulation applies the stated FP8 number with no extra sparse multiplier.
